description: Permissions, hooks, env, and per-project overrides for biu. Same shape applies to ~/.biumind/settings.json, .biumind/settings.json, and .biumind/settings.local.json.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema; lets IDEs auto-validate without project config.

claudeMdExcludes.description: Glob patterns of BIUMIND.md / CLAUDE.md files to skip when loading project memory.

env.description: Environment variables exported into the agent process at session start.

hooks.description: Lifecycle commands keyed by event name (PreToolUse, PostToolUse, UserPromptSubmit, …).

model.description: Override the default model when this layer is active.

additionalDirectories.description: Extra cwd ancestors the agent is allowed to read/write.

allow.description: Tool(content) rules that pre-approve calls. Format: `Tool(pattern)` — Tool ∈ {Bash, Read, Edit, Write, Glob, Grep, …, *}; pattern is a glob/prefix.

ask.description: Tool(content) rules that always prompt regardless of mode. Format: `Tool(pattern)` — Tool ∈ {Bash, Read, Edit, Write, Glob, Grep, …, *}; pattern is a glob/prefix.

defaultMode.description: Mode applied at session start; can be flipped at runtime with /mode.

deny.description: Tool(content) rules that block calls outright; deny wins over allow. Format: `Tool(pattern)` — Tool ∈ {Bash, Read, Edit, Write, Glob, Grep, …, *}; pattern is a glob/prefix.

sandbox.description: Filesystem allow/deny lists for the Bash tool's sandbox layer. See docs/biu/sandbox.md for a full guide. Path values may use `~` (home), `${VAR}` (env), and `${PROJECT_ROOT}` (project cwd); relative paths are dropped. Three-layer merge is union-only — project / local can ADD entries, none can remove or override earlier layers' entries.

fsReadAllowWithinDeny.description: Re-permits reads inside an fsReadDeny entry. Example: block ~/.aws but keep ~/.aws/config readable.

fsReadDeny.description: Paths the sandbox blocks reads to. Use for credentials and secrets (~/.ssh, ~/.aws, ~/.config/gcloud).

fsWriteAllowExtra.description: Extra writable roots beyond the project cwd. Example: ${PROJECT_ROOT}/build, /tmp/biu-cache.

fsWriteDenyWithinAllow.description: Surgical write denies inside an fsWriteAllowExtra root. The complement of fsReadAllowWithinDeny.

statusLine.description: User shell command rendered as the right cluster of the REPL status bar. The command receives a small JSON payload on stdin; first line of stdout becomes the segment text. Errors / non-zero exits silently degrade to no segment.

timeoutMs.description: Cap on execution time in milliseconds. 0 → package default (5 s).

type.description: Reserved for future shapes; today only "command" is supported.

title: biu settings.json
